title: Wingthing: persist unacknowledged unread state across navigator reopen
description:
## Source:

Binding spec: /work/lanes/skeptic/inputs/mac/drive/wingthing-app-spec.md and /work/lanes/wt-app/PRD.md. Original item/comments: /work/lanes/refine-wingthing/evidence/fleet-itwd.show.json and .comments.json.

Card: 03/card-2, ordinal #3: 3 · Blocked now; unread next
Source: /work/lanes/wt-e2e/wingthing/evidence/storyboard-source/03-navigator.html#3
Carrier: f8f9ebd96e1c72336ffd796c8d496ecda0a85619; Linux forge; isolated HOME/WINGTHING_DIR; fixture provider/SSH, real built wt + kernel PTY.

Expected screen: Blocked lifecycle, separate unread badge/count and acknowledgement
Expected observable state: Hook cursors scoped by machine/session; completion not exit; unacknowledged unread cursor persists for same viewer across navigator reopen

Actual outcome across three runs: FAIL, FAIL, FAIL.


## Why

Bryan does not lose attention signals merely by reopening his daily navigator.

## The one question / capability

Does unread work remain visible when Bryan closes and reopens the same navigator?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing. Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-itwd-20261011; isolated checkout, record actual head and binary hash. internal/dashboard/attention.go, attention_test.go and a local durable viewer-cursor store (new); cmd/wt navigator construction and TestStoryboardNavigatorCard2/durable-unread-cursor. Reuse completed WT-07 transition/projection source; add only cross-process persistence for the same viewer, never rebuild recent-run discovery.

## Non-goals

No duplicate source-DONE implementation, Linux confinement bypass, public release/deploy, account/payment/provider spend or external outreach. Bare wt stays primary; free SSH/LAN/tailnet stay available and automatic Pro offers default OFF. Use disposable fixture sessions and installer transports; actual user/native/physical acceptance remains separately evidenced.

## Acceptance

Execute TestStoryboardNavigatorCard2 and its durable-unread-cursor subtest three times with no skip/missing match. Emit an unacknowledged native event, close/reopen same viewer and preserve unread badge/count until explicit acknowledgement of that exact machine/wing/session cursor. Acknowledgement survives restart; other viewers and equal session names on different wings remain independent. Concurrent writes are atomic; corrupt/missing persistence reports unknown/incomplete rather than silently acknowledged. Read/unread and blocked/completed/process-exit remain distinct; no automatic acknowledge on open/refresh. Persist IDs/cursors only, with local private file permissions and no transcript/secrets. go test -race ./internal/dashboard and focused cmd/wt tests plus vet/full suite vs baseline. Native hooks require separate exact-head Mac receipts, not synthetic PASS.
 MOCKS-FIRST: proposed happy/failure screenshots must receive builder self-review and separate product-review PASS against each named view question before UI implementation; revise and re-review failed mocks, then review actual screenshots/transcripts after build.

## UI contract / MOCKS-FIRST gate

User: Bryan does not lose attention signals merely by reopening his daily navigator. One question per view: Navigator attention: which exact work is still unread for me? Reference: /work/lanes/wt-app/storyboard (flow matching source card), existing dense keyboard navigator and docs/pairing/STORYBOARD.html. Before UI build, capture happy/failure mock screens at narrow/wide sizes with readable focus/status, then self-review and obtain independent product-review PASS. Revise failures before building; review actual screenshots/transcripts again after build.

## Review loop

Builder reviews every diff/card expectation against the one question and clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated/no-one-shot rubric. Independent gpt-6.1-sol high implementation/evidence review before handoff; security reviewer checks policy, cursor or route authority changes. Fix findings and re-review. Product mocks must pass before UI work; coordinator integrates shared files serially.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: fleet-jugv. Tracking parent is not a blocker. Preserve native/physical gates and current active owner; do not create another suite lane.

## V/C

V=9/10; C=5 remaining agent-hours including implementation/qualification and review, excluding human wait. Rationale: Bryan does not lose attention signals merely by reopening his daily navigator. Original V/C=6/1.3 uses board scheduling units, retained in evidence rather than compared as hours.

Acknowledgement survives restart; other viewers and equal session names on different wings remain independent. Read/unread and blocked/completed/process-exit remain distinct; no automatic acknowledge on open/refresh. ## Source:

## Why

Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic.

## The one question / capability

What is the next unmet gate to useful Wingthing work for Bryan and customers?

## Scope

Repo: ehrlich-b/wingthing (https://github.com/ehrlich-b/wingthing). Base: codex/wt-integration-20261011 @ 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca; record actual integrated head after coordinator composes brief11. Branch: codex/refine-fleet-9e8778acfc12-20261011. Work in an isolated checkout; retain existing active lane/assignee/status and coordinate shared files through the integration owner. docs/product/RELEASE-GATES.md and existing child map in integration checkout; track task IDs, source vs native/physical/customer evidence and decisions. Aggregate only; no duplicate implementation or automatic dispatch. First-session/forge precede physical phone/external pilot, then paid cloud, then teams/density.

## Non-goals

No duplicate completed source, public release/deploy/outreach, real billing/provider/account mutation or spending in the local implementation slice. Use temporary state and fixture transports for automated acceptance. Physical/provider/customer acceptance requires separate owner-approved receipts; do not label fixture passes as those gates. Bare wt stays the entrypoint; free local/SSH/LAN/tailnet remain; automatic Pro offers OFF by default.

## Acceptance

Every live child maps to one goal and receipt or exact unmet gate; DONE source never presented as physical/release success. fleet-7zpb bare-wt install/local-only/OFF-default upsells remains explicit unmet gate. Parent stays tracking-only; checklist links existing children and approvals with no duplicate beads.

## Review loop

Builder self-reviews the diff and evidence against the one question, source requirements and failure cases, revising until clear/purposeful/testable/minimal/deduplicated with no one-shot traps. A separate gpt-6.1-sol reviewer checks implementation, evidence and remaining gates before handoff; security/authority changes also require an independent security reviewer. Fix every failed acceptance or review finding and re-review changed scope. Coordinator reviews exact head and retained REQUIRED-UNRUN gates; Bryan owns any stated external decision.

## Dependencies

Blocking IDs: none. Parent hierarchy is tracking, not a prerequisite. Retain existing external/native/approval blockers; conditional work never bypasses them.

## V/C

V=10/10; C=2 agent-hours remaining. Rationale: Bryan and the coordinator see the next useful gate without a sprawling implementation epic. Estimate includes bounded implementation/receipt analysis, self-review and independent review; human wait time excluded. Old C used mixed board/engineer-day units and is preserved in the audit, not treated as hours.

Integration base reconciliation: 3a0b7fa8578b9889d9e17a0e5fb3a1ffab9831ca is a verified descendant of the independently reviewed 0a2b2d26b4fcf50cf8ead4ffce0fa4e6e50071ad. The new commit keeps Mac confinement required and corrects Linux terminal fixture assertions; this pin does not claim native acceptance. Preserve the reviewed mini-PRD and additive lead gates in future updates; source DONE verdicts are unchanged.

## Resumed refinement reconciliation

Closed fleet-7zpb delivered blocked artifacts only, with no product implementation. Live fleet-kxez now owns its undelivered first-run/local-only/OFF-default offer product scope; require its actual acceptance before this dependent gate. Existing closed dependency is historical, not proof of completion.
